dataQuality.text: The workbook contains a single worksheet, 'PPC CAD Milestone'. No 'PPC CAD P1' sheet exists.
EOP cells D31:D33 (XCB / Megane E-Tech) contain the number 2029 formatted as a date (displayed 'juil-05'). Interpreted as year 2029 — to be confirmed.
Mercedes (25 lines, YMOK): no EOP and no milestone in the source. Data Required.
Ford (YMOK, B87:B94): BU label present but no project line, EOP or milestone. Data Required.
The source does not say whether a 'YMM1 & YMM2' line belongs to YMM1 or YMM2. Plant is left null (TBC) and must be set in the app.
XHN Program: EOP 07/2030 appears on the first row only (row 40); rows 41–42 are blank in the source. They probably share it — to be confirmed, not assumed.
EOP year earlier than 2027 (source values 2025/2026). Check whether these lines are still active in 2027; two of them carry an 'EOP' milestone in W01 2027.
Lines with an EOP but no 2027 milestone in the grid (excluding Mercedes).
Several rows share the same BU, project and EOP (e.g. G7x SP25 Serie 7 ×4). The source does not state what distinguishes them; rows are kept separate and identified by sourceRow.

Milestone types are inferred from label text (typeInferred=true). The source colours are kept in sourceColor. Only EOP (End of Production) and SOP (Start of Production) are defined by the business; other acronyms are kept verbatim.
Week numbers W01–W52 are taken from the sheet header. Calendar dates assume ISO-8601 weeks (W01 = Monday 2027-01-04); this mapping is an assumption.
Only two milestones span several weeks in the source: PU11-27 VS2 (W15–W19) and PU11-27 DOC (W27–W29). All others occupy one week (startWeek = endWeek).
